The Manual sidebar uses compact one-line labels, removes duplicate section-number prefixes, groups the five wizard steps, and exposes keyboard-accessible two- and three-level disclosure controls.
The first Manual introduction renders as one combined web paragraph without changing either downloadable Markdown or PDF edition.
